comparison: Phase 1 retained workbench snapshot vs phase 2 segmented storage and virtualized workbench
interpretation: Work volume and mounted DOM counts are the main results. No real browser/WebView latency, native rendering, FPS, durable disk I/O or browser quota behavior was measured. Instrumented Node and jsdom times are retained only as local observations.

methodology.fixture: 1000 or 5000 conversations; 4 messages each; 256 ASCII content characters per message; one immutable conversation object changed; 1000 navigation updates coalesced before flush
methodology.backing: Unlimited in-memory Map. No browser quota, disk access, WebView IPC, DOM or layout. The 5000-conversation fixture may exceed real localStorage quota.
methodology.work: Actual adapter source. Explicit synchronous flush excludes the 500 ms debounce and idle scheduling. Navigation is measured after a committed history save. Cold hydration creates a new adapter against the saved values.
methodology.instrumentation: Counts successful storage operations, JSON calls, and conversation toJSON calls. UTF-8 byte counts are serialized values only, not UTF-16 browser quota or key overhead. Instrumented Node wall time is not UI response latency.
methodology.tradeoff: Per-conversation records reduce repeated body serialization while increasing storage keys and synchronous cold reads. Metadata indexes and the previous recovery index remain proportional to conversation count.

methodology.fixture: 1000 conversations; active conversation has 1000 alternating user/assistant messages, other conversations have one user message. Assistant content has a heading, bold text and link. All history remains in the store.
methodology.execution: Actual App and stores, Vite module bundle, React.StrictMode, fresh jsdom process. Source bundling is outside the reported time. Bootstrap and persistence are stubbed; the status-poll API and EventSource are mocked.
methodology.geometry: Synthetic transcript clientHeight 600, clientWidth 760; virtual sidebar clientHeight 480. ResizeObserver reports no measurements; jsdom has no CSS layout, paint or native scrolling.
methodology.markdown: No Web Worker in jsdom. Phase 2 uses its idle asynchronous fallback; count taken after visible Markdown finishes.
methodology.timing: One observation of Node/jsdom React mount + lazy imports + asynchronous formatting + 20ms settle polling. Not browser startup time, input latency, animation FPS or a statistically estimated speedup.
methodology.count: Element counts include actual mounted DOM. No CSS visibility approximation is used; active transcript is identified by data-transcript-active. The new shell can add fixed elements while lists remove offscreen rows.
